framework.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Federal Information Security Controls
framework.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 provides a comprehensive catalog of security and privacy controls for federal information systems and organizations. Organized into 20 control families with 1,000+ control enhancements — the gold standard for FedRAMP, DoD, and defense contractor accreditation.
